answer: One opal, three layers. An umber bond of 60 POA, +25 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 1,725 POA. The juniper layer is a live challenge from another identity's last output, answered inside one shared 30-minute window. The opal layer needs three strangers with three-epoch opals to co-sign; each vouches for at most two opals an epoch. One operator re-cuts at most two opals a window, so ten fakes need five hands, thirty strangers, ten live answers at once. Layers are checked apart: a farm can buy bonds, not five hands and thirty strangers in one window.
